title: Creative Representation
description: One equivalent trafficking representation retained within a CreativeRepresentationSet before seller binding. `representation_id` is stable within its parent revision and identifies a representation, not rotation, A/B content, build output, locale, or a seller's served execution variant.

representation_id.description: Stable representation identifier, unique within the enclosing CreativeRepresentationSet revision.

source_representation.description: Source system's human-readable name for this representation.

source_id.description: Optional immutable source-system identifier for this representation.
